(1) the pseudo‐observation method provides valid and efficient causal inference in survival data, and (2) the pseudo‐observations can be computed in a variety of ways that are appropriate for specific situations, such as when the outcome is censored or when the treatment assignment is time‐varying.

(1) causal inference in survival data is possible using the pseudo‐observation approach and (2) the pseudo‐observation estimator is consistent and has a standard asymptotic normal distribution under standard conditions.
